items.statement: Correct complete objects, conserved stoichiometry, declared states and energy reference. Validate actual atom maps and raw calculation identity before dependent scores. Use fused 2a C18H20B10 and nonfused source precursor1a C18H21B10Br, both neutral singlets. Precursor1a is 1-(8-bromonaphthalen-1-yl)-2-phenyl-o-carborane; it is not a pure geometric un-fusion because Br/H composition differs. Public graph edits remove the B3-aryl fusion edge, restore B3-H and add aryl-Br. Preserve the closo cage adjacency and mapped cage C1-C2 axis; a multicenter cage edge is not an ordinary two-center bond-order assertion. Primary THF continuum.
